scope: Technical audit of every original record against authoritative dataset indexes/mappings; no textbook or scientific rationale verification.
execution: Real server-only registry/grader/loaders transpiled by installed TypeScript; only server-only poison marker replaced. No grader, content, scoring or auth mocks. No Supabase calls.

coverage.representation: Every nonmatching record, including numerical-choice and True/False, grades its canonical choice index. Choice-table classification uses row index; matching classification uses ordered selections. Datasets provide no authoritative educational subtype field; no prompt-based subtype guesses were made.
coverage.matchingIncorrectCoverage: All single-item substitutions across every answer-bank option plus all-items-wrong and differing reversed mappings. Not enumeration of the full Cartesian space of multi-item responses.
coverage.shuffleCoverage: All permutations and every displayed position for every ordinary question, mapped back to its canonical index. Hypothetical testing only: no protected question or matching exercise was newly shuffled in the application.
